correctness.rationale: Correct for all integer N>=2 and gamma>0, with unmodified first-order Korobov full-lattice weights against mu(t)=pi|sin(2pi t)|/2. The minimum-norm periodic H1 interpolant has cellwise bubble -4pi^2 gamma ubar b_N; integrating gives w_j=H_j-[4pi^2 gamma B_N/(N(1+pi^2 gamma/(3N^2)))]. The Fourier coefficients of mu and the nonnegative hat Fourier multipliers give H_j>=H_0; direct sine/cotangent integration gives H_0 and B_N. B_N>1/(12N^2), H_0<=1/N establish a positive unique gamma threshold, equal-zero and negative above; Taylor expansion yields Gamma_N=N+pi^2/3+O(N^-1). Independently compared formulas with prior identical theorem; finite direct-solve source verifier was inspected, not mistaken for the infinite proof.
